data: What is the value of the green line at the '256' entity space dimensionality on the Sports & Outdoors plot?

The green line represents the word2vec baseline. The '256' entity space dimensionality corresponds to the point where the x-axis intersects with the label '256'. At this point, the green line appears to be approximately at the 0.15 mark on the y-axis. Therefore, the value of the green line at the '256' entity space dimensionality on the Sports & Outdoors plot is approximately 0.15.
